definitions.explanation: the lowest possible point or state; often used figuratively to describe the worst circumstances in life, finances, or emotions

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧どん{底|ぞこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I experienced rock bottom in life.

examples.japanese: どん{底|ぞこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{這|は}い{上|あ}がった→這い上がる：06269_haiagaru⟧。
examples.english: I climbed back up from rock bottom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どん{底|ぞこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。

notes:
EXPRESSIVE NOUN:
どん{底|ぞこ} is an emphatic word for the absolute lowest point. The prefix どん～ intensifies ⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧ (bottom).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どん{底|ぞこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to experience rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ - to fall to rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{這|は}い{上|あ}がる→這い上がる：06269_haiagaru⟧ - to crawl up from rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ - life at rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ - state of being at rock bottom
